note.appearance.font.family: "Monospace" changes the interface font (sidebar, buttons, settings). Code blocks and tool output are always monospace, and message text is unaffected.
note.appearance.code.font: The last two options need that font installed; otherwise the system monospace stack is used, so no glyph ever renders blank.
note.appearance.content.width: "Fixed 768" keeps a comfortable reading width of about 40–60 characters per line; "Fluid" follows the window and panel width.
note.session.busy.delivery: "Join current" interrupts the answer in progress; "Next turn" sends automatically once this turn ends. Both deliveries are not implemented yet, so only the preference is stored.
note.session.clear.session: Only the interface cache is cleared: Pi's session JSONL is never deleted or rewritten.
session.blocked.no.session: No session is open right now
session.blocked.temporary: A temporary session ends when closed, so its cache cannot be cleared alone
session.blocked.running: This turn has not finished yet; clear the cache once it does
system.note.notify.on.complete: When off, finished sessions and runtime errors no longer raise a notification. "Awaiting input" still does, because it needs your reply.
system.note.minimize.to.tray: On: the close button only hides the window, the process and sessions keep running, and the tray restores it. Off: the close button quits the process.
system.note.reset.layout: Panel widths are fixed tokens today (no dragging): resetting reopens both panels and returns message text to "Fixed 768".
system.note.data.directory: "Open data folder" locates it with the system file manager and is read-only: clicking never writes a file. Deleting the folder also removes imported community language packs.
system.note.about: Connection: {status} · Platform: {platform} · Pi owns the session files; SOXU only reads an index of them.
